meta.title: School Admission
meta.description: Admission process and school fees {year} at Kreativa Global School for Kindergarten, Primary, Secondary, and High School.

steps.title: Application Submission
steps.body: Complete the Registration Form at admission.kreativaglobal.sch.id.

steps.title: Student Observation
steps.body: Through student observations, we learn more about each prospective student and their readiness to begin school.

steps.title: Parents Interview
steps.body: In this interview, parents will discuss their family values, educational expectations, and their child's development with the school. It's also an opportunity for parents to ask questions and better understand the environment and programs at Kreativa Global School.

steps.title: Admission Decision
steps.body: The school will decide if your child is accepted or not.

steps.title: Enrollment
steps.body: If Accepted, Complete enrollment by submitting documents and paying fees.

steps.title: Parent Orientation
steps.body: In the Parents Orientation, parents will learn about the school, meet the teachers, and understand how the school works. Parents will get tips on supporting their child and how to stay informed. This session helps parents feel ready as their child joins Kreativa Global School.

steps.title: Student Orientation
steps.body: During the Student Orientation, students from all levels will be introduced to the school environment, meet their teachers and new friends, and get to know the learning routines and expectations. They will also learn about school values, daily activities, and important guidelines to help them feel confident, comfortable, and ready to start their journey at Kreativa Global School.

fees.title: School Fees {year}
fees.currencyNote: All amounts are in Indonesian Rupiah (Rp).

closing.text: Kreativa Global: Where your potential is valued, your dreams are nurtured, and your future shines brightly.
